title.full: Who can use the Healthier SG Chronic Tier

summary.text: You need a CHAS, PG, or MG card and must be enrolled with a Healthier SG GP clinic.

details.heading: Who is eligible
details.body: You do not need to be a CHAS cardholder specifically. You can qualify as a CHAS, Pioneer Generation, or Merdeka Generation cardholder, as long as you are enrolled with a Healthier SG GP clinic.

example_phrasings: Do I need a CHAS card for the Chronic Tier?
Can PG or MG cardholders use the Chronic Tier?
What do I need for Healthier SG Chronic Tier?

sources.page_title: Do I need to be a Community Health Assist Scheme (CHAS) cardholder to enjoy the Healthier SG Chronic Tier under Healthier SG from 2024?

quotes.text: You will need to be a CHAS/ Pioneer Generation (PG)/ Merdeka Generation (MG) cardholder and be enrolled with a Healthier SG GP clinic to be eligible for the Healthier SG Chronic Tier.
